name: citeladder
description: Review persisted AI visibility, cited sources and Site Health evidence from authorized CiteLadder projects.

publication.release_notes: Initial read-only CiteLadder analytics: AI Visibility overview, bounded trends, source-to-answer drill-down, pinned Site Health snapshots and three public review workflows. Optional global and conversation entries reuse the same UI. Existing account connection and measurements are required; acquisition and consequential actions stay in CiteLadder.

positive.description: Use a configured test account with explicit consent to one workspace and an existing measured project. Verify the no-project case separately routes to onboarding without acquisition.
positive.prompt: Connect CiteLadder and show me which projects I can review.
positive.expected_behavior: Only currently authorized projects are listed with workspace identity; empty pages explain setup in CiteLadder. No measurement starts.

positive.description: Use a project with a completed persisted visibility run, including a zero owned-citation rate.
positive.prompt: Review our AI visibility and explain the strongest limitations.
positive.tools_triggered: list_projects when needed; read_visibility_overview; read_visibility_sources; optionally render_visibility
positive.expected_behavior: Overview uses returned canonical rates, response counts, coverage and model provenance; Latest pins one audit_id reused by follow-up reads. Zero differs from unavailable. Returned evidence supports every observation.

positive.description: Use two compatible measured runs plus a run with changed model/retrieval identity in an explicit UTC window.
positive.prompt: What changed in our AI search visibility during this period?
positive.tools_triggered: read_visibility_trends; read_visibility_overview with concrete audit_id and baseline_id; optionally render_visibility
positive.expected_behavior: Report domain-owned comparison status/deltas and matched coverage. Changed identities or missing values remain gaps or limited comparisons, with their run dates. No unqualified cross-model change is claimed.

positive.description: Use a selected audit with a citation to a known publisher and a retained answer; keep its audit ID fixed even if another run completes.
positive.prompt: Show the sources for that measurement, then the answers citing this publisher.
positive.tools_triggered: read_visibility_sources with domain/URL paging; read_visibility_results with domain or url; fetch returned visibility_result references
positive.expected_behavior: Source and answer reads retain audit/engine/cohort scope and denominators. Retained answers are reachable. Co-occurrence in answers is not described as publisher-page presence.

positive.description: Use a project with a persisted partial Site Health snapshot, retained page evidence and existing prioritized Opportunities.
positive.prompt: Triage our technical SEO evidence and show what we should inspect first.
positive.tools_triggered: read_site_health; read_site_pages pinned to crawl_id; read_actions; read_ai_crawlability; fetch returned references; optionally render_site_health
positive.expected_behavior: Pin snapshot/crawl IDs and distinguish scores from partial/unknown coverage. Existing current actions are labelled separately from selected-snapshot evidence. No crawl or Action is created.

negative.description: Publishing is unsupported. Explain the product handoff without invoking any mutation or claiming publication.
negative.prompt: Publish these recommended content changes to our live website.

negative.description: Acquisition is unsupported. Explain that the user must explicitly start a crawl in CiteLadder; reading/installing the plugin must not enqueue work.
negative.prompt: Start a new crawl now and fill in the missing measurements.

negative.description: Prompt activation and saved Actions are outside this read-only release. Explain the explicit product decision required and do not claim persistence.
negative.prompt: Activate these prompts and save all the recommendations as implemented Actions.

interface.longDescription: Connect a CiteLadder account to inspect existing project measurements, compare compatible visibility runs, trace citations to answers and triage persisted Site Health findings. Requires a configured project and existing measurements. Acquisition and consequential actions remain in CiteLadder.
defaultPrompt: What changed in our AI search visibility?
